definitions.explanation: Having qualities seen as characteristic of Japan or the Japanese, especially in ways of thinking, customs and systems.

examples.japanese: {日本的|にほんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧。
examples.english: A typically Japanese way of thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{日本的|にほんてき}だ。

⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本的|にほんてき}な⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧きた。
examples.english: Seniority-based pay and promotion has long been called a feature of Japanese-style employment.

notes:
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ + 〜⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Common in discussions of culture, business and society, often set against {西洋的|せいようてき} (Western).

- {日本的|にほんてき}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: a Japanese way of thinking
- {日本的|にほんてき}⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: Japanese-style management
- {日本的|にほんてき}な⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧: Japanese beauty, a Japanese aesthetic
